title: John praised Mary because he? Implicit Causality Bias and Its Interaction with Explicit Cues in LMs

bias_targets.methodology: Using a cloze task with mismatched-gender subject and object proper nouns to measure the probability of models predicting 'he' vs 'she' following the connective 'because', determining if the language models naturally attribute causality to the subject or the object of specific interpersonal verbs.

Varying the gender of the subject and object proper names (e.g., John and Mary) in the prompt stimuli and evaluating the baseline probability of male vs. female pronouns to discount gender preference as a confounding variable.
